title: Localization and common-stage transport of the integral mates
statement:
Fix the finite-field datum $D=(k_0,k)$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], a prime $\ell\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], an algebraic closure $\Omega$ and an embedding $E\hookrightarrow\Omega$ [def-weil-algebraically-closed-coefficients]. Let $X_0$ be separated and of finite type over $k_0$, and let $j_0:U_0\hookrightarrow X_0$, $i_0:Z_0\hookrightarrow X_0$ be complementary open and closed immersions [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Their base changes, specified coefficient functors and mate predicates are those of [def-sf-open-closed-weil-mate-data]. Then sfRationalizationOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl E j₀ i₀ ∧
    sfRationalScalarOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl E j₀ i₀ ∧
    sfCommonStageOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl Ω j₀ i₀. Its notions and specified comparisons use [def-weil-frobenius-detailed], [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom], [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [def-weil-rationalization-karoubi], [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support], [def-weil-derived-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate], [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-conjugate], [def-weil-weil-sheaf-complex], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image], [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data], [def-sf-integral-open-operations], [def-sf-integral-open-reduction-comparison-data], [def-pod-integral-completed-comparison-data], [def-zl-field-weil-shriek-shift-data], [def-zl-common-stage-weil-shriek], [def-zl-frobenius-compact-support-comparison], [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-pullback], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-square], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-open-adjunction], [def-sp-finite-intrinsic-direct-adjunction], [def-sp-coefficient-mate-comparisons], [def-sp-open-coefficient-adjunction-data], [def-zl-weil-ind-sheaf-category], [def-weil-pbc-bounded-constructible-tower].

proof.text: Restrict the normalized integral adjunctions to the constructible categories. Localize their functors, units and counits over the coefficient uniformizer. The published rational pullback has these localized objects and maps, so its comparison components are identities. Adjoint uniqueness identifies its chosen open and closed adjoints with the localized adjoints, with comparisons given by the prescribed mates. Tensoring the integral pullback cubes and unit/counit identities with one gives all rational mate equations. The published rational scalar comparison is the localization of the integral comparison; repeat this argument for each finite coefficient extension. Finally represent all finitely many objects and morphisms over one common finite field. The stage-system functor construction descends the adjunctions and equations, and its pullback inclusion components are the specified identities. Mate pasting preserves the two three-factor words at every passage.

theorem sf_openClosed_weil_descent_stage
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E] [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (_ιE : E →ₐ[Padic l] Ω)
    {X₀ U₀ Z₀ : Over (Spec (.of D.k₀))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X₀.hom] [QuasiCompact X₀.hom] [IsSeparated X₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType U₀.hom] [QuasiCompact U₀.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Z₀.hom] [QuasiCompact Z₀.hom]
    (j₀ : U₀ ⟶ X₀) (i₀ : Z₀ ⟶ X₀)
    [IsOpenImmersion j₀.left] [IsClosedImmersion i₀.left]
    (_hij : Set.range i₀.left.base = (Set.range j₀.left.base)ᶜ) :
    sfRationalizationOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl E j₀ i₀ ∧
    sfRationalScalarOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl E j₀ i₀ ∧
    sfCommonStageOpenClosedWeilMateAssertions D l hl Ω j₀ i₀
